reviews.title: We need to talk about the thought process of GoWish
reviews.text:
First point, your app’s algorithm is based on stereotypes influenced by the clear bigotry behind it. People are complex and have extremely specific preferences. and the only thing you could do is base everything off their age and ‘gender’ (Side note - What is gender to you? You used the terms female and male to describe gender, and exclude intersex/non-binary people entirely.)

Second point (probably the last one), the artificially generated advertising used to promote your app shows how you don’t care for it. Seriously, I was disappointed using an art app and seeing gen AI. I have nothing else to say, goodbye

reviews.title: Too generalised
reviews.text: The app in my opinion is very useful, but it’s very generalised, there’s no option for sub-genders (even just having non-binary would be a massive improvement). One of the problems I’ve come across is that for my age (13-14) everything is fidgets, clothes, jellycats and perfumes. It’s way too stereotypical girly. We want tech and anime and fun stuff too. Not just stereotypically girly things. I also wish we could put in things that we liked so that it gave us recommendations based off of things we already like. Another problem I faced is the CONSTANT refreshing! It does not need to refresh every three seconds! I was scrolling for ages and I finally found a top I liked, but when I went to click on it to add it to my wishlist the page refreshed for the 10th time in FIVE MINUTES!

reviews.title: I don’t really recommend for younger birthdays

I’m not saying the ads were false information, but in one ad I saw someone typing their child’s gender and age (6 year old) and it came up with lovely recommendations. (By the way my brother is turning older than 6 years (turning 9) and it still didn’t show anything. Not much of a variety, like if u flip through age 11-12 it is the same things. Whatever works, works for you but this app is definitely not for me.
